description:
Use this to compare several financing what-ifs for ONE listing side by side in one call (for example cash
down, term, credit tier or APR, trade-in, incentives). Each scenario reruns the itemized out-the-door estimate and
returns estimated_out_the_door, amount_financed_estimate, apr_percent and apr_source, term_months,
estimated_monthly_payment (rounded to $5) with a range, total_interest_estimate and total_cost_estimate (cash down
plus all payments), plus lowest_monthly and lowest_total_cost. Up to 6 scenarios. For a single scenario use
get_payment_estimate. Estimate, not an offer; dealer sets price, lender sets rate. Leases are not modeled.

PaymentScenario.description: One what-if finance scenario. Omitted fields use the call's defaults ($0 down, 60 months, good credit).

credit_tier.description: Picks the demo APR when apr is omitted.
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives the buyer qualifies for.
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

payoff.description: Loan payoff owed on the trade-in, USD.
payoff.title: Payoff

trade_equity.description: Net trade equity if allowance and payoff are unknown; no tax credit.
trade_equity.title: Trade Equity

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD (gets the state's trade-in tax credit).
trade_value.title: Trade Value

PaymentScenario.title: PaymentScenario

buyer_state.description: Buyer's two-letter state for tax and fees. Default: the selling store's state.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's five-digit ZIP; sets state and city when buyer_state is omitted.
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

scenarios.description: 1 to 6 what-if scenarios, e.g. [{"name":"0 down"},{"name":"3k down 72","down_payment":3000,"term_months":72}]. Omitted fields default to $0 down, 60 months, good credit.
scenarios.title: Scenarios

name: compare_payment_scenarios
